label: UTC Timestamp
description: Chronological hourly index in UTC; prevents timezone DST duplicates.

label: Global Horizontal / Tilted Irradiance
description: Solar irradiance incident on plane of array or horizontal surface.

label: Ambient Air Temperature
description: Outdoor dry-bulb temperature affecting PV cell efficiency and dryer heat losses.

label: Wind Speed (10m)
description: Wind velocity influencing convective PV module cooling.

label: Ambient Relative Humidity
description: Ambient air relative humidity governing drying air moisture-carrying capacity.

label: Photovoltaic Electrical Power
source: PVGIS PVcalc / System Model (Predicted in Phase 5)
description: AC electrical output from PV array. Target variable for Model 1.

label: Sand Bed Bulk Temperature
description: Average temperature of the sand thermal energy storage medium.

label: HTF Inlet Temperature
description: Heat-transfer-fluid temperature entering the sand storage heat exchanger.

label: HTF Outlet Temperature
description: Heat-transfer-fluid temperature exiting toward the biomass dryer indirect HX.

label: Thermal Storage Charging Flag
description: Binary indicator showing whether thermal storage is actively receiving heat.

label: Thermal Storage Discharging Flag
description: Binary indicator showing whether thermal storage is supplying heat to the dryer.

label: Usable Stored Thermal Energy
description: Usable sensible thermal energy above minimum extraction temperature.

label: Wet Biomass Batch Mass
description: Mass of wet agricultural residue fed into the dryer.

label: Biomass Initial Moisture Content (Wet Basis)
description: Moisture fraction of incoming agricultural residue before drying.

label: Biomass Target Moisture Content (Wet Basis)
description: Required outlet moisture percentage prior to slow pyrolysis.

label: Dryer Inlet Air Temperature
description: Heated air temperature entering the biomass drying chamber.

label: Dryer Exhaust Air Temperature
description: Moist exhaust air temperature exiting the biomass dryer.

label: Biomass Dryer Thermal Demand
description: Required thermal power to evaporate water and cover dryer heat losses. Target for Model 2.

label: NCG Combustion Recovered Thermal Power
description: Useful thermal power recovered from combusting non-condensable pyrolysis gas.

label: NCG Burner Operating Status
description: Read-only indicator of active NCG combustion (PLC safety supervised).
